# FPI Services

> Aircraft maintenance and storage provider based at Kotoka International Airport (ACC / DGAA), Accra, Ghana. FPI Services serves ATR 72, Embraer E-Jet and Boeing 737 fleets across West Africa.

FPI Services delivers line maintenance, base maintenance to C-check level, aircraft storage and preservation, and 24/7 AOG (Aircraft-on-Ground) support, backed by a documented quality and safety management system aligned with international airworthiness standards.

## Services
- [Line Maintenance & AOG Support](https://fpiservices.net/services/line-maintenance.html): Ramp and transit checks, defect rectification and 24/7 aircraft-on-ground response.
- [Base Maintenance & C Checks](https://fpiservices.net/services/base-maintenance.html): Scheduled C checks, structural repairs and modifications.
- [Aircraft Storage & Preservation](https://fpiservices.net/services/hangar-storage.html): Short- and long-term parking, preservation and return-to-service.

## Key pages
- [Capability & Turnaround Check](https://fpiservices.net/capability-check.html): Instantly check capability coverage for an aircraft type and requirement.
- [24/7 AOG Support](https://fpiservices.net/aog.html): Emergency aircraft-on-ground contact and dispatch.
- [Network & Coverage](https://fpiservices.net/network.html): West-African regional coverage from the Accra hub.
- [Careers](https://fpiservices.net/careers.html): Licensed engineer, planning and quality roles.
- [Sustainability](https://fpiservices.net/sustainability.html): Responsible maintenance operations.

## Facts
- Location: Kotoka International Airport (ACC / DGAA), Accra, Greater Accra, Ghana
- Fleets served: ATR 72, Embraer E-Jets (E170/175/190/195), Boeing 737 (NG / MAX)
- Contact: sales@fpiservices.net · +233 55 435 2912 · 24/7 AOG desk
